engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
technicalNotes:
Depending on the Generation of the Airbag Kontrol Modülü this Fault Code may be reset/cleared up to 2 times. If the Code is stored another time, the Kontrol Modülü will store a different Fault Code (Kontrol Modülü: Faulty) and needs to be replaced.
Specific Details (i.e. under which Circumstances the Module would need to be replaced or can be reused) can be found in the Factory Repair Manual for each Model.
